versos.grego: Παῦλος δέσμιος Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ καὶ Τιμόθεος ὁ ἀδελφὸς Φιλήμονι τῷ ἀγαπητῷ καὶ συνεργῷ ἡμῶν

controles.web: Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus, and Timothy our brother, to Philemon, our beloved fellow worker,
controles.kjv: Paul, a prisoner of Jesus Christ, and Timothy our brother, unto Philemon our dearly beloved, and fellowlabourer,
controles.livre: Paulo, prisioneiro de Cristo Jesus, e o irmão Timóteo, a Filemom, o amado, e nosso cooperador;

versos.grego: καὶ Ἀπφίᾳ τῇ ἀδελφῇ καὶ Ἀρχίππῳ τῷ συστρατιώτῃ ἡμῶν καὶ τῇ κατ’ οἶκόν σου ἐκκλησίᾳ·

controles.web: to the beloved Apphia, to Archippus, our fellow soldier, and to the assembly in your house:
controles.kjv: And to our beloved Apphia, and Archippus our fellowsoldier, and to the church in thy house:
controles.livre: E à irmã  Ápia, e a Arquipo nosso companheiro de batalha, e à igreja que está em tua casa;

versos.grego: χάρις ὑμῖν καὶ εἰρήνη ἀπὸ Θεοῦ Πατρὸς ἡμῶν καὶ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ.

controles.web: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
controles.kjv: Grace to you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
controles.livre: Haja em vós graça e paz de Deus nosso Pai, e do Senhor Jesus Cristo.

versos.grego: Εὐχαριστῶ τῷ Θεῷ μου πάντοτε μνείαν σου ποιούμενος ἐπὶ τῶν προσευχῶν μου,

controles.web: I thank my God always, making mention of you in my prayers,
controles.kjv: I thank my God, making mention of thee always in my prayers,
controles.livre: Eu dou graças a meu Deus sempre me lembrando de ti em minhas orações;

versos.grego: ἀκούων σου τὴν ἀγάπην καὶ τὴν πίστιν ἣν ἔχεις πρὸς τὸν Κύριον Ἰησοῦν καὶ εἰς πάντας τοὺς ἁγίους,

controles.web: hearing of your love, and of the faith which you have toward the Lord Jesus, and toward all the saints;
controles.kjv: Hearing of thy love and faith, which thou hast toward the Lord Jesus, and toward all saints;
controles.livre: Ao ouvir de teu amor e a fé que tu tens para com o Senhor Jesus, e para com todos os santos;

versos.grego: ὅπως ἡ κοινωνία τῆς πίστεώς σου ἐνεργὴς γένηται ἐν ἐπιγνώσει παντὸς ἀγαθοῦ τοῦ ἐν ἡμῖν εἰς Χριστόν·

controles.web: that the fellowship of your faith may become effective, in the knowledge of every good thing which is in us in Christ Jesus.
controles.kjv: That the communication of thy faith may become effectual by the acknowledging of every good thing which is in you in Christ Jesus.
controles.livre: Para que a comunhão de tua fé seja eficaz no reconhecimento de todo o bem que há em vós por Cristo Jesus.

versos.grego: χαρὰν γὰρ πολλὴν ἔσχον καὶ παράκλησιν ἐπὶ τῇ ἀγάπῃ σου, ὅτι τὰ σπλάγχνα τῶν ἁγίων ἀναπέπαυται διὰ σοῦ, ἀδελφέ.

controles.web: For we have much joy and comfort in your love, because the hearts of the saints have been refreshed through you, brother.
controles.kjv: For we have great joy and consolation in thy love, because the bowels of the saints are refreshed by thee, brother.
controles.livre: Porque nós temos grande alegria e consolo em teu amor, pelo qual, por meio de ti, irmão, os sentimentos dos santos foram aliviados.

versos.grego: Διό, πολλὴν ἐν Χριστῷ παρρησίαν ἔχων ἐπιτάσσειν σοι τὸ ἀνῆκον,

controles.web: Therefore though I have all boldness in Christ to command you that which is appropriate,
controles.kjv: Wherefore, though I might be much bold in Christ to enjoin thee that which is convenient,
controles.livre: Por isso, ainda que em Cristo eu tenha grande confiança para te mandar aquilo que te é conveniente,

versos.grego: διὰ τὴν ἀγάπην μᾶλλον παρακαλῶ, τοιοῦτος ὢν ὡς Παῦλος πρεσβύτης νυνὶ δὲ καὶ δέσμιος Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ,

controles.web: yet for love’s sake I rather beg, being such a one as Paul, the aged, but also a prisoner of Jesus Christ.
controles.kjv: Yet for love’s sake I rather beseech thee, being such an one as Paul the aged, and now also a prisoner of Jesus Christ.
controles.livre: Em vez disso por amor eu te peço, ainda que eu seja tal, Paulo, o velho, e também agora um prisioneiro de Jesus Cristo;

versos.grego: παρακαλῶ σε περὶ τοῦ ἐμοῦ τέκνου, ὃν ἐγέννησα ἐν τοῖς δεσμοῖς, Ὀνήσιμον,

controles.web: I beg you for my child, whom I have become the father of in my chains, Onesimus,
controles.kjv: I beseech thee for my son Onesimus, whom I have begotten in my bonds:
controles.livre: Eu te peço por meu filho Onésimo, ao qual eu gerei durante minhas prisões.

versos.grego: τόν ποτέ σοι ἄχρηστον νυνὶ δὲ καὶ σοὶ καὶ ἐμοὶ εὔχρηστον,

controles.web: who once was useless to you, but now is useful to you and to me.
controles.kjv: Which in time past was to thee unprofitable, but now profitable to thee and to me:
controles.livre: Aquele que antes te era inútil, mas agora útil para mim e para ti,

versos.grego: ὃν ἀνέπεμψά σοι αὐτόν, τοῦτ’ ἔστιν τὰ ἐμὰ σπλάγχνα·

controles.web: I am sending him back. Therefore receive him, that is, my own heart,
controles.kjv: Whom I have sent again: thou therefore receive him, that is, mine own bowels:
controles.livre: Eu o enviei, como os meus mais íntimos sentimentos, de volta a ti;

versos.grego: ὃν ἐγὼ ἐβουλόμην πρὸς ἐμαυτὸν κατέχειν, ἵνα ὑπὲρ σοῦ μοι διακονῇ ἐν τοῖς δεσμοῖς τοῦ εὐαγγελίου,

controles.web: whom I desired to keep with me, that on your behalf he might serve me in my chains for the Good News.
controles.kjv: Whom I would have retained with me, that in thy stead he might have ministered unto me in the bonds of the gospel:
controles.livre: Eu até que gostaria de retê-lo comigo, para que como teu substituto ele me servisse nas prisões do Evangelho;

versos.grego: χωρὶς δὲ τῆς σῆς γνώμης οὐδὲν ἠθέλησα ποιῆσαι, ἵνα μὴ ὡς κατὰ ἀνάγκην τὸ ἀγαθόν σου ᾖ ἀλλὰ κατὰ ἑκούσιον.

controles.web: But I was willing to do nothing without your consent, that your goodness would not be as of necessity, but of free will.
controles.kjv: But without thy mind would I do nothing; that thy benefit should not be as it were of necessity, but willingly.
controles.livre: Mas eu nada quis fazer sem tua opinião, para que tua bondade não fosse como que por obrigação, mas sim de livre vontade.

versos.grego: τάχα γὰρ διὰ τοῦτο ἐχωρίσθη πρὸς ὥραν, ἵνα αἰώνιον αὐτὸν ἀπέχῃς,

controles.web: For perhaps he was therefore separated from you for a while, that you would have him forever,
controles.kjv: For perhaps he therefore departed for a season, that thou shouldest receive him for ever;
controles.livre: Porque talvez por isso que ele tenha se separado de ti por algum tempo, para que tu o recebesses de volta para sempre.

versos.grego: οὐκέτι ὡς δοῦλον ἀλλὰ ὑπὲρ δοῦλον, ἀδελφὸν ἀγαπητόν, μάλιστα ἐμοί, πόσῳ δὲ μᾶλλον σοὶ καὶ ἐν σαρκὶ καὶ ἐν Κυρίῳ.

controles.web: no longer as a slave, but more than a slave, a beloved brother, especially to me, but how much rather to you, both in the flesh and in the Lord.
controles.kjv: Not now as a servant, but above a servant, a brother beloved, specially to me, but how much more unto thee, both in the flesh, and in the Lord?
controles.livre: Não mais como a um servo, mas sim mais que um servo, como a um amado irmão, especialmente para mim, e muito mais de ti, tanto na carne como no Senhor.

versos.grego: εἰ οὖν με ἔχεις κοινωνόν, προσλαβοῦ αὐτὸν ὡς ἐμέ.

controles.web: If then you count me a partner, receive him as you would receive me.
controles.kjv: If thou count me therefore a partner, receive him as myself.
controles.livre: Portanto, se tu me tens como companheiro, então recebe-o como a mim.

versos.grego: εἰ δέ τι ἠδίκησέν σε ἢ ὀφείλει, τοῦτο ἐμοὶ ἐλλόγα·

controles.web: But if he has wronged you at all, or owes you anything, put that to my account.
controles.kjv: If he hath wronged thee, or oweth thee ought, put that on mine account;
controles.livre: E se ele te fez algum dano, ou te deve alguma coisa ,põe isto na minha conta.

versos.grego: ἐγὼ Παῦλος ἔγραψα τῇ ἐμῇ χειρί, ἐγὼ ἀποτίσω· ἵνα μὴ λέγω σοι ὅτι καὶ σεαυτόν μοι προσοφείλεις.

controles.web: I, Paul, write this with my own hand: I will repay it (not to mention to you that you owe to me even your own self besides).
controles.kjv: I Paul have written it with mine own hand, I will repay it: albeit I do not say to thee how thou owest unto me even thine own self besides.
controles.livre: Eu, Paulo, de minha própria mão o escrevi, eu pagarei; para eu não te dizer que tu me deves a ti mesmo.

versos.grego: ναί, ἀδελφέ, ἐγώ σου ὀναίμην ἐν Κυρίῳ· ἀνάπαυσόν μου τὰ σπλάγχνα ἐν Χριστῷ.

controles.web: Yes, brother, let me have joy from you in the Lord. Refresh my heart in the Lord.
controles.kjv: Yea, brother, let me have joy of thee in the Lord: refresh my bowels in the Lord.
controles.livre: Assim, irmão, que eu tenha algum benefício de ti no Senhor; alivia meus sentimentos no Senhor.

versos.grego: Πεποιθὼς τῇ ὑπακοῇ σου ἔγραψά σοι, εἰδὼς ὅτι καὶ ὑπὲρ ἃ λέγω ποιήσεις.

controles.web: Having confidence in your obedience, I write to you, knowing that you will do even beyond what I say.
controles.kjv: Having confidence in thy obedience I wrote unto thee, knowing that thou wilt also do more than I say.
controles.livre: Tendo confiança de tua obediência eu te escrevi, sabendo que tu farás ainda mais do que eu digo.

versos.grego: ἅμα δὲ καὶ ἑτοίμαζέ μοι ξενίαν· ἐλπίζω γὰρ ὅτι διὰ τῶν προσευχῶν ὑμῶν χαρισθήσομαι ὑμῖν.

controles.web: Also, prepare a guest room for me, for I hope that through your prayers I will be restored to you.
controles.kjv: But withal prepare me also a lodging: for I trust that through your prayers I shall be given unto you.
controles.livre: E enquanto isso também me prepara um lugar para eu ficar; porque eu espero que por vossas orações eu seja entregue a vós.

versos.grego: Ἀσπάζεταί σε Ἐπαφρᾶς ὁ συναιχμάλωτός μου ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ,

controles.web: Epaphras, my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus, greets you,
controles.kjv: There salute thee Epaphras, my fellowprisoner in Christ Jesus;
controles.livre: Saúdam-te: Epafras (meu companheiro de prisão em Cristo Jesus),

versos.grego: Μᾶρκος, Ἀρίσταρχος, Δημᾶς, Λουκᾶς, οἱ συνεργοί μου.

controles.web: as do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, my fellow workers.
controles.kjv: Marcus, Aristarchus, Demas, Lucas, my fellowlabourers.
controles.livre: Marcos, Aristarco, Demas e Lucas (meus cooperadores).

versos.grego: Ἡ χάρις τοῦ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ μετὰ τοῦ πνεύματος ὑμῶν.

controles.web: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.
controles.kjv: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.  Written from Rome to Philemon, by Onesimus a servant.
controles.livre: A graça de nosso Senhor Jesus Cirsto seja com vosso espírito. Amém!
